name: Naturalisation

requirements.blocker_text: 5 years of legal residence in Luxembourg, with the final year immediately preceding the application being uninterrupted.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of legal residence, with the final year uninterrupted.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a Luxembourgish language test pass certificate.
Must complete the 'Vivre ensemble au Grand-Duche de Luxembourg' civics/integration course, or pass an exam covering its content.
requirements.fix_path: Complete the civics course or pass the exam.

requirements.blocker_text: Refused for false statements, concealment, or fraud; or for criminal/custodial sentences of 12+ months or suspended sentences of 24+ months (foreign convictions count if they would constitute a Luxembourg crime, unless more than 15 years have passed or rehabilitation occurred).

evidence_required.document: Proof of 5 years' legal residence (final year uninterrupted)
Civics course completion certificate or exam pass

sources.title: Guichet.lu -- Acquiring Luxembourgish Nationality by Naturalisation: 5-year residence, Luxembourgish language test, 'Vivre ensemble' civics course/exam, good-repute conduct standard

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Luxembourg). Luxembourg's standard naturalisation bar (5 years) is notably short by this dataset's standards, offset by a genuinely mandatory Luxembourgish-language test (not merely one option among several languages, unlike e.g. Finland's Finnish/Swedish choice) and a dedicated civics course/exam -- both hard requirements, not soft/discretionary factors. This is a grand-ducal-decree naturalisation procedure, structurally distinct from the separate 'acquisition by option' declaration procedures (10 sub-cases covering descendants, spouses, long-term residents of 20+ years, protected persons, and others) -- see lu_citizenship_by_descent.json and lu_citizenship_by_marriage.json for the two option cases modeled as separate files in this dataset; the remaining option cases (parents of Luxembourgish minors, persons born in Luxembourg, 7-years-of-LU-schooling, 20-year long-term residents, integration-contract participants, early settlers, protected persons, volunteer soldiers) are not modeled as separate route files but are disclosed here for completeness.
